rows.note: For the approval sense, this is the all-purpose colloquial adjective meaning fine, good, or lovely.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 hou2 wo3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when “grand” means exceptionally impressive, powerful, or intense.

example.english: That new computer of yours is really grand!
example.jyutping: nei5 bou6 san1 din6 nou5 hou2 ging6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the grandeur comes from an imposing visual presence, scale, or atmosphere.

example.jyutping: go3 mou5 toi4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3

rows.note: Use this for lofty greatness or an illustrious, dignified person or institution rather than merely a striking appearance.

example.english: They made a grand contribution to society.
example.traditional: 佢為社會作出偉大貢獻。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 se5 wui6 zok3 ceot1 wai5 daai6 gung3 hin3
